FundOrderRecord.description:
Internal counterpart of a fund order (PRD §8.3 fund_orders).

``FundOrderView`` is the public, read-only projection (no internal account
or idempotency keys); this record carries the persistence fields the domain
needs to drive confirm/settle/expiry system events without re-deriving them.
FundOrderRecord.title: FundOrderRecord

ScheduleEventJob.description:
First-execution job produced alongside instruction creation.

``source_id`` identifies the instruction that produced this job;
``period_key`` is a deterministic period label (e.g. ISO-8601 of first
due_at) so that ``(source_id, period_key)`` is unique.
